SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   B. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   B. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   D. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   B. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   D. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   C. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

8. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   B. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.

9. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   C. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.

10. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   B. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   B. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   D. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.
   D. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

15. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   B. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
